```{r helpers, include=FALSE}
# ── Utility ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pmax_na <- function(...) {
  x <- pmax(..., na.rm = TRUE); x[is.infinite(x)] <- NA_real_; x
}
round_numeric <- function(df, digits = 5) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  df %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., digits)))
}
remove_outliers <- function(x) {
  q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE); q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  ifelse(x < (q1 - 1.5*iqr) | x > (q3 + 1.5*iqr), NA_real_, x)
}
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "—", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))

# ── Rolling helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
roll_avg_with_days <- function(x, n) {
  x0 <- fifelse(is.na(x), 0, x)
  d  <- as.integer(!is.na(x))
  s  <- frollsum(x0, n = n, align = "right")
  k  <- frollsum(d,  n = n, align = "right")
  avg <- fifelse(k > 0L, s / k, NA_real_)
  list(avg = avg, days = k)
}
roll_sd <- function(x, n) {
  if (length(x) == 0) return(numeric(0))
  frollapply(x, n = n, FUN = function(w) {
    valid <- w[!is.na(w)]
    if (length(valid) >= 3L) sd(valid) else NA_real_
  }, align = "right")
}

# ── Outcome helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
calc_y_horizon <- function(days_to_event, horizon_days) {
  as.integer(!is.na(days_to_event) & days_to_event >= 1L & days_to_event <= horizon_days)
}

# ── Model builders ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_recipe_glmnet <- function(train_df) {
  recipe(Y ~ ., data = train_df) %>%
    step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_novel(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.01) %>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors())
}
make_recipe_xgboost <- function(train_df) {
  recipe(Y ~ ., data = train_df) %>%
    step_novel(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.01) %>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = FALSE, -all_outcomes()) %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors())
}

# ── Undersampling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
undersample_by_patient <- function(df, ratio = 3L, seed = 2026L) {
  set.seed(seed)
  df <- as_tibble(df)
  df %>%
    group_by(PatientICN) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      pos <- .x %>% filter(Y == 1); neg <- .x %>% filter(Y == 0)
      if (nrow(pos) == 0L) {
        if (nrow(neg) > 0L) neg[sample.int(nrow(neg), min(8L, nrow(neg))), ] else .x[0L, ]
      } else {
        n_neg <- min(nrow(pos) * ratio, nrow(neg))
        neg_s <- if (nrow(neg) > 0L && n_neg > 0L)
          neg[sample.int(nrow(neg), n_neg), ] else .x[0L, ]
        bind_rows(pos, neg_s)
      }
    }) %>% ungroup()
}

# ── Metrics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
compute_global_metrics <- function(y, pred) {
  valid <- !is.na(y) & !is.na(pred)
  y <- y[valid]; pred <- pred[valid]
  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(response = y, predictor = pred, quiet = TRUE, direction = "<")
  auc_val <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
  brier   <- mean((pred - y)^2)
  pr_auc  <- tryCatch({
    PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = pred[y == 1], scores.class1 = pred[y == 0],
                    curve = FALSE)$auc.integral
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  eps   <- 1e-6
  logit_p <- log(pmax(eps, pred) / pmax(eps, 1 - pred))
  cal_slope <- tryCatch(
    coef(suppressWarnings(glm(y ~ logit_p, family = binomial())))[["logit_p"]],
    error = function(e) NA_real_)
  list(roc = roc_obj, auc = auc_val, pr_auc = pr_auc, brier = brier, cal_slope = cal_slope)
}

make_calibration_table <- function(pred, y) {
  tibble(predicted_prob = pred, actual = y) %>%
    mutate(prob_bin = cut(predicted_prob,
      breaks = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1),
      labels = c("0–20%","20–40%","40–60%","60–80%","80–100%"),
      include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
    group_by(prob_bin) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), n_events = sum(actual),
              mean_predicted = mean(predicted_prob),
              observed_rate  = mean(actual), .groups = "drop") %>%
    round_numeric()
}

# ── Feature importance helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
classify_feature <- function(nm) {
  case_when(
    str_detect(nm, "k_steps_|baseline_k_steps|low_activity") ~ "Step / PGHD",
    str_detect(nm, "bmi_|map_|pulse|bun_|albumin_|leuk_|spo2")    ~ "Vitals / Labs",
    str_detect(nm, "py2_inpat|py_ed|py_urgent|py_appt")           ~ "Healthcare Use",
    str_detect(nm, "^py2_")                                        ~ "Condition flags",
    str_detect(nm, "Age|Gender|Race|Ethnicity|Married|GISURH|PriorityGroup|season") ~ "Demographic",
    str_detect(nm, "mst_|smoker|tobacco")                          ~ "Social history",
    TRUE                                                            ~ "Other"
  )
}

```{r data-load, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE, eval = FALSE}

data_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "data", "input")

# ── Preflight check — fail fast if any upstream file is missing ──────────────
path_cohort <- file.path(data_dir, "cohort_full_demo.parquet")
path_pghd   <- file.path(data_dir, "pghd_final_full.parquet")
path_inpat  <- file.path(data_dir, "inpat_daily.parquet")
path_ed     <- file.path(data_dir, "ed_urgent_daily.parquet")
path_cond   <- file.path(data_dir, "patient_condition_flags_prior.parquet")
path_hcu    <- file.path(data_dir, "hc_util_prior.parquet")
path_vitals <- file.path(data_dir, "final_vitals_features_with_splines.parquet")
path_hf     <- file.path(data_dir, "final_health_factors_tobacco_mst.parquet")

missing_files <- Filter(
  Negate(file.exists),
  c(path_cohort, path_pghd, path_inpat, path_ed, path_cond, path_hcu, path_vitals, path_hf))
if (length(missing_files) > 0L)
  stop("Missing upstream parquet file(s):\n  ", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n  "))

# ── Load parquets ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

```{r}
cohort_full_demo  <- open_dataset(path_cohort) %>% collect()
.cohort_icns_vec  <- cohort_full_demo %>% distinct(PatientICN) %>% pull(PatientICN)
pghd_daily_raw    <- open_dataset(path_pghd) %>%
                       filter(PatientICN %in% .cohort_icns_vec) %>%
                       select(PatientICN, date, date_first, date_last, obs_end,
                              ah_das_exercise_m,
                              ah_das_exercise_sec,
                              ah_das_exercise_steps,
                              fit_das_exercise_m,
                              fit_das_exercise_sec,
                              fit_das_exercise_steps,
                              gar_das_exercise_m,
                              gar_das_exercise_sec,
                              gar_das_exercise_steps) %>%
                       collect()

rm(.cohort_icns_vec); gc()
inpat_daily       <- open_dataset(path_inpat)  %>% collect()
ed_urgent_daily   <- open_dataset(path_ed)     %>% collect()
cond_flags        <- open_dataset(path_cond)   %>% collect()
hcu_prior         <- open_dataset(path_hcu)    %>% distinct() %>% collect()
vitals_features   <- open_dataset(path_vitals) %>% collect()
health_factors    <- open_dataset(path_hf)     %>%
                       select(-any_of("date_first")) %>% collect()

# ── Build static features table ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Short-term fix: exclude patients whose recorded date_first == 2023-06-01 because
# the PGHD pull only starts on that date — these are prevalent uploaders whose true
# enrollment date is unknown.  A 90-day grace period (≥ 2023-09-01) ensures only
# genuinely incident enrollees are included.  Remove once the pull is extended back
# to 2022-01-01 (permanent fix in generate_cohort.R).
cohort_static <- cohort_full_demo %>%
  #filter(as.Date(date_first) >= as.Date("2023-09-01")) %>%
  left_join(cond_flags,      by = "PatientICN") %>%
  left_join(hcu_prior,       by = "PatientICN") %>%
  left_join(vitals_features, by = "PatientICN") %>%
  left_join(health_factors,  by = "PatientICN")

# Convert date columns
inpat_daily     <- inpat_daily     %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date))
ed_urgent_daily <- ed_urgent_daily %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date))
```

```{r feature-engineering, include=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STUDY 1 FEATURE ENGINEERING  (mirrors 3C.15 pipeline exactly)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Step 0: Build cohort_daily ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# pghd_daily_raw is pre-filtered to cohort patients in data-load (Arrow push-down),
# so no semi_join needed here — filter directly to the observation window.
cohort_daily <- pghd_daily_raw %>%
  mutate(date       = as.Date(date),
         date_first = as.Date(date_first),
         obs_end    = as.Date(obs_end)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date_first),
         date_first >= as.Date("2023-09-01"),   # same grace-period cutoff as cohort_static
         date >= date_first, date <= obs_end) %>% # trim to obs window
  left_join(cohort_full_demo %>% select(PatientICN, dod),             by = "PatientICN") %>%
  left_join(inpat_daily   %>% select(PatientICN, date, inpat_any),   by = c("PatientICN","date")) %>%
  left_join(ed_urgent_daily %>% select(PatientICN, date, ed),         by = c("PatientICN","date")) %>%
  mutate(inpat_any = coalesce(inpat_any, 0L),
         ed        = coalesce(ed, 0L))

gc()

# ── Outlier removal ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cohort_daily <- cohort_daily %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(starts_with("ah_das_"), starts_with("fit_das_"), starts_with("gar_das_"),
      starts_with("ah_wo_"),  starts_with("fit_wo_"),  starts_with("gar_wo_"),
      starts_with("ah_sleep_"),starts_with("fit_sleep_"),starts_with("gar_sleep_")),
    remove_outliers))

# ── Device coalescing ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cohort_steps <- cohort_daily %>%
  transmute(
    PatientICN, date = as.Date(date),
    date_first = as.Date(date_first), obs_end = as.Date(obs_end), dod = as.Date(dod),
    ed, inpat_any,
    fit_garmin_steps     = pmax_na(fit_das_exercise_steps, gar_das_exercise_steps),
    apple_steps          = ah_das_exercise_steps,
    fit_garmin_exercise_m = pmax_na(fit_das_exercise_m, gar_das_exercise_m),
    apple_exercise_m     = ah_das_exercise_m
  )
```
```{r}
# ── Build dynamic_daily ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dynamic_daily <- cohort_steps %>%
  group_by(PatientICN) %>% arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    daily_steps     = coalesce(fit_garmin_steps,      apple_steps),
    daily_exercise_m = coalesce(fit_garmin_exercise_m, apple_exercise_m)
  ) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(c(daily_steps, daily_exercise_m), ~if_else(. == 0, NA_real_, .)),
         died = if_else(!is.na(dod) & as.Date(dod) == date, 1L, 0L),
         days_since_first = as.integer(difftime(date, as.Date(date_first), units = "days")))

# ── First event per person ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
event_types <- dynamic_daily %>%
  group_by(PatientICN) %>% arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(had_event = as.integer(ed == 1 | inpat_any == 1 | died == 1)) %>%
  summarise(
    first_event_date = { d <- date[had_event==1]; if (length(d)==0) as.Date(NA) else min(d) },
    first_event_type = {
      d <- date[had_event==1]
      if (length(d)==0) NA_character_
      else {
        fe <- min(d); r <- pick(everything()) %>% filter(date == fe)
        case_when(r$died[1]==1 ~ "Death", r$inpat_any[1]==1 ~ "Inpatient", TRUE ~ "ED Visit")
      }
    }, .groups = "drop")
```

```{r daily-processing, include=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
dynamic_daily <- dynamic_daily %>%
  left_join(event_types, by = "PatientICN")

# ── Step imputation (OLS: steps ~ exercise_m) ─────────────────────────────────
dt_daily <- as.data.table(dynamic_daily)
dt_daily[, date := as.Date(date)]; dt_daily[, obs_end := as.Date(obs_end)]
setorder(dt_daily, PatientICN, date)

imp_train <- dt_daily[!is.na(daily_steps) & !is.na(daily_exercise_m),
                      .(steps = as.numeric(daily_steps), exercise_m = as.numeric(daily_exercise_m))]
step_imp_model <- if (nrow(imp_train) >= 50L)
  suppressWarnings(lm(steps ~ exercise_m, data = as.data.frame(imp_train))) else NULL

dt_daily[, daily_steps_imp := as.numeric(daily_steps)]
ni <- which(is.na(dt_daily$daily_steps_imp) & !is.na(dt_daily$daily_exercise_m))
if (length(ni) > 0L && !is.null(step_imp_model)) {
  pred_imp <- predict(step_imp_model,
    newdata = data.frame(exercise_m = as.numeric(dt_daily$daily_exercise_m[ni])))
  dt_daily$daily_steps_imp[ni] <- pmax(0, pred_imp)
}

# ── Upload episode detection (21-day gap) ─────────────────────────────────────
dt_daily[, any_upload_today := as.integer(!is.na(daily_steps) | !is.na(daily_exercise_m))]
dt_upload <- dt_daily[any_upload_today == 1L, .(PatientICN, date)]
setorder(dt_upload, PatientICN, date)
dt_upload[, gap := as.integer(date - shift(date)), by = PatientICN]
dt_upload[, new_ep := as.integer(is.na(gap) | gap >= 21L)]
dt_upload[, upload_episode := cumsum(new_ep), by = PatientICN]

pt_obs_end  <- dt_daily[, .(pt_obs_end = max(date)), by = PatientICN]
ep_ranges   <- dt_upload[, .(ep_start = min(date)), by = .(PatientICN, upload_episode)]
ep_ranges[pt_obs_end, on = "PatientICN", pt_obs_end := i.pt_obs_end]
ep_ranges[, next_start := shift(ep_start, type = "lead"), by = PatientICN]
ep_ranges[, ep_end := as.Date(fifelse(!is.na(next_start),
                                       as.character(next_start - 1L),
                                       as.character(pt_obs_end)))]

dt_daily[, upload_episode := NA_integer_]
dt_daily[ep_ranges, on = .(PatientICN, date >= ep_start, date <= ep_end),
         upload_episode := i.upload_episode]

# ── Rolling features ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dt_daily[, c("steps_7d_avg","steps_7d_days") := {
  r <- roll_avg_with_days(daily_steps_imp, 7L); list(r$avg, r$days)
}, by = PatientICN]
dt_daily[, k_steps_7d_avg       := steps_7d_avg / 1000]
dt_daily[, k_steps_7d_miss_days := as.integer(7L - fifelse(is.na(steps_7d_days), 0L, steps_7d_days))]
dt_daily[, k_steps_7d_all_missing := fifelse(is.na(steps_7d_days), 0L, as.integer(steps_7d_days == 0L))]
dt_daily[, k_steps_7d_sd := roll_sd(daily_steps_imp, 7L) / 1000, by = PatientICN]

dt_daily[, is_low_activity := as.integer(!is.na(daily_steps_imp) & daily_steps_imp < 1000)]
dt_daily[, low_activity_streak := {
  s <- integer(length(is_low_activity)); cur <- 0L
  for (i in seq_along(is_low_activity)) {
    if (is.na(is_low_activity[i])) { s[i] <- NA_integer_; cur <- 0L
    } else if (is_low_activity[i] == 1L) { cur <- cur + 1L; s[i] <- cur
    } else { s[i] <- 0L; cur <- 0L }
  }; s
}, by = PatientICN]
dt_daily[, low_activity_days_7d := frollsum(is_low_activity, n = 7L, align = "right"), by = PatientICN]

dt_daily[, c("steps_14d_avg","steps_14d_days") := {
  r <- roll_avg_with_days(daily_steps_imp, 14L); list(r$avg, r$days)
}, by = PatientICN]
dt_daily[, k_steps_14d_avg := steps_14d_avg / 1000]
dt_daily[, k_steps_14d_sd  := roll_sd(daily_steps_imp, 14L) / 1000, by = PatientICN]

dt_daily[, c("steps_21d_avg","steps_21d_days") := {
  r <- roll_avg_with_days(daily_steps_imp, 21L); list(r$avg, r$days)
}, by = PatientICN]
dt_daily[, k_steps_21d_avg := steps_21d_avg / 1000]
dt_daily[, k_steps_21d_sd  := roll_sd(daily_steps_imp, 21L) / 1000, by = PatientICN]

# ── Weekly aggregation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dt_daily[, weekly_end_date := as.Date((as.integer(date) %/% 7L)*7L, origin = "1970-01-01") + 6L]
```

```{r weekly-aggregation, include=FALSE, cache=TRUE, dependson="daily-processing", eval = FALSE}
weekly_cols <- c("date","obs_end",
  "k_steps_7d_avg","k_steps_7d_miss_days","k_steps_7d_all_missing","k_steps_7d_sd",
  "low_activity_days_7d","low_activity_streak",
  "k_steps_14d_avg","k_steps_14d_sd","k_steps_21d_avg","k_steps_21d_sd")

dt_weekly <- dt_daily[!is.na(upload_episode),
  .SD[which.max(date)],
  by = .(PatientICN, upload_episode, weekly_end_date),
  .SDcols = weekly_cols]
setorder(dt_weekly, PatientICN, upload_episode, weekly_end_date)

dt_weekly[, window_has_core := as.integer(!is.na(k_steps_7d_avg) & k_steps_7d_avg >= 0.5)]
ep_core <- dt_weekly[, .(ep_valid = any(window_has_core == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(PatientICN, upload_episode)]
dt_weekly <- merge(dt_weekly, ep_core, by = c("PatientICN","upload_episode"), all.x = TRUE)
dt_weekly <- dt_weekly[ep_valid == TRUE & window_has_core == 1L]

ep_ord <- dt_weekly[, .(ep_start = min(weekly_end_date)), by = .(PatientICN, upload_episode)]
setorder(ep_ord, PatientICN, ep_start)
ep_ord[, ep_order       := frank(ep_start, ties.method = "dense"), by = PatientICN]
ep_ord[, first_ep_order := min(ep_order), by = PatientICN]
dt_weekly <- merge(dt_weekly, ep_ord[, .(PatientICN, upload_episode, ep_order, first_ep_order)],
                   by = c("PatientICN","upload_episode"), all.x = TRUE)
dt_weekly <- dt_weekly[ep_order >= first_ep_order]

setorder(dt_weekly, PatientICN, weekly_end_date)
dt_weekly[, weekly_interval_index := seq_len(.N), by = PatientICN]

# Percent-change features (vs previous 3 windows; winsorized ±500%)
dt_weekly[, `:=`(
  lag1 = shift(k_steps_7d_avg, 1L),
  lag2 = shift(k_steps_7d_avg, 2L),
  lag3 = shift(k_steps_7d_avg, 3L)
), by = .(PatientICN, upload_episode)]
dt_weekly[, prev3 := rowMeans(cbind(lag1, lag2, lag3), na.rm = TRUE)]
dt_weekly[is.nan(prev3), prev3 := NA_real_]
dt_weekly[, k_steps_7d_avg_pctdiff := {
  raw <- 100 * (k_steps_7d_avg - prev3) / prev3
  raw <- fifelse(!is.na(prev3) & prev3 >= 0.10, raw, NA_real_)
  pmax(pmin(raw, 500), -500)
}]
dt_weekly[, c("lag1","lag2","lag3","prev3") := NULL]

```

```{r consort-pipeline, include=FALSE, dependson="weekly-aggregation", eval = FALSE}
# ── Load cohort parameters from single source of truth ───────────────────────
source("cohort_config.R")

# ── Merge event types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dt_analysis <- merge(dt_weekly, event_types, by = "PatientICN", all.x = TRUE)
dt_analysis[, days_to_event := as.integer(first_event_date - weekly_end_date)]
dt_analysis[is.na(first_event_type), first_event_type := "No Event"]
dt_analysis[, first_upload_date := min(weekly_end_date), by = PatientICN]

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONSORT PIPELINE — capture N patients and N person-weeks at each step
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Recompute derived dates now that data is loaded ───────────────────────────
data_end_raw          <- max(as.Date(pghd_daily_raw$date), na.rm = TRUE)
last_observable       <- data_end_raw  - max_horizon
followup_cutoff       <- last_observable - max_follow_up_days
followup_cutoff_label <- format(followup_cutoff, "%B %d, %Y")
data_start_date       <- format(inception_cutoff, "%B %d, %Y")
data_end_date         <- format(data_end_raw,     "%B %d, %Y")

# Step 0: starting cohort — incident enrollees with first upload ≥ inception_cutoff
# (90-day grace period removes left-truncated prevalent uploaders; see cohort_static filter)
dt_analysis <- dt_analysis[first_upload_date >= inception_cutoff]
n0_pts  <- uniqueN(dt_analysis$PatientICN)
n0_wks  <- nrow(dt_analysis)

# Step 1: require first upload on or before followup_cutoff
# (ensures every patient has ≥ max_follow_up_days of potential observation)
dt_analysis <- dt_analysis[first_upload_date <= followup_cutoff]
n1_pts <- uniqueN(dt_analysis$PatientICN)
n1_wks <- nrow(dt_analysis)

# Step 2: weekly data quality filter (≥4 upload days in a given week, i.e. miss_days ≤ 3)
dt_analysis <- dt_analysis[k_steps_7d_miss_days <= 3]
n2_pts <- uniqueN(dt_analysis$PatientICN)
n2_wks <- nrow(dt_analysis)

# Step 3: require ≥7 total weeks (6 event-free baseline + ≥1 observation week)
n3_before <- uniqueN(dt_analysis$PatientICN)
pt_wk_cts <- dt_analysis[, .(tot = .N), by = PatientICN]
dt_analysis <- dt_analysis[PatientICN %in% pt_wk_cts[tot >= 7L, PatientICN]]
n3_pts <- uniqueN(dt_analysis$PatientICN)
n3_wks <- nrow(dt_analysis)

# Compute 6-week baseline metrics
baseline_metrics <- dt_analysis[weekly_interval_index <= 6L,
  .(baseline_k_steps_avg = mean(k_steps_7d_avg, na.rm = TRUE),
    baseline_k_steps_miss_days = mean(k_steps_7d_miss_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    baseline_end_date = max(weekly_end_date)),
  by = PatientICN]
dt_analysis <- merge(dt_analysis, baseline_metrics, by = "PatientICN", all.x = TRUE)

# Step 3b: require event-free baseline — exclude patients whose composite event
# occurred during weeks 1–6.  These patients have no event-free baseline to
# anchor predictions on; without this step they would be silently dropped inside
# Step 4 (censor_date < all observation-week end dates → 0 rows retained).
event_in_baseline <- dt_analysis[
  weekly_interval_index <= 6L & !is.na(first_event_date),
  .(baseline_event = any(as.Date(first_event_date) <= as.Date(baseline_end_date))),
  by = PatientICN][baseline_event == TRUE, PatientICN]
dt_analysis <- dt_analysis[PatientICN %!in% event_in_baseline]
n3b_pts <- uniqueN(dt_analysis$PatientICN)
n3b_wks <- nrow(dt_analysis)

# Move to observation period (weeks 7+) and compute pct-from-baseline
dt_analysis <- dt_analysis[!is.na(baseline_k_steps_avg) & weekly_interval_index > 6L]
dt_analysis[, k_steps_7d_pct_from_baseline :=
              100 * (k_steps_7d_avg - baseline_k_steps_avg) / baseline_k_steps_avg]

# Step 4: event classification + censoring at event or max_follow_up_days (intervals removed, patients same)
dt_analysis[, obs_window_end  := first_upload_date + max_follow_up_days]
dt_analysis[, event_within_window := !is.na(first_event_date) & first_event_date <= obs_window_end]
dt_analysis[, censor_date := fifelse(
  event_within_window,
  first_event_date,
  obs_window_end)]

# ── Save pre-step4 snapshot BEFORE censoring filter (for diagnostics) ─────────
as_tibble(dt_analysis) %>%
  write_parquet("data/output/dt_analysis_pre_step4.parquet")

dt_analysis <- dt_analysis[weekly_end_date <= censor_date]
dt_analysis[event_within_window == FALSE,
  `:=`(first_event_date = NA_Date_, days_to_event = NA_integer_, first_event_type = "No Event")]
n4_pts <- uniqueN(dt_analysis$PatientICN)    # same as n3 — censoring only drops intervals
n4_wks <- nrow(dt_analysis)                  # fewer intervals

# ── Patient-level summary (for Table 1 and Figure 2) ──────────────────────────
patient_summary <- dt_analysis[,
  .(first_event_type       = first(first_event_type),
    first_event_date       = first(first_event_date),
    days_to_event_from_start = as.integer(difftime(first(first_event_date),
                                                   first(first_upload_date), units = "days")),
    total_weeks            = .N,
    baseline_k_steps_avg   = first(baseline_k_steps_avg),
    baseline_k_steps_miss  = first(baseline_k_steps_miss_days),
    obs_k_steps_avg        = mean(k_steps_7d_avg,         na.rm = TRUE),
    obs_k_steps_sd         = sd(k_steps_7d_avg,           na.rm = TRUE),
    obs_miss_days_avg      = mean(k_steps_7d_miss_days,   na.rm = TRUE),
    obs_pct_baseline_avg   = mean(k_steps_7d_pct_from_baseline, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = PatientICN]

# Join static features into patient summary for Table 1
tbl1_data <- as_tibble(patient_summary) %>%
  left_join(cohort_static %>% select(
    PatientICN, Age, Gender, Race, Ethnicity,
    any_of(c("Married","MaritalStatus")), GISURH, PriorityGroup,
    starts_with("py2_"), py_ed, py_urgent, py_appt_no_show,
    bmi_fitted_mean, bmi_slope, map_fitted_mean, recent_pulse,
    bun_value_mean, albumin_value_mean, leuk_value_mean,
    mst_status, tobacco_status), by = "PatientICN") %>%
  mutate(
    first_event_type = factor(first_event_type,
      levels = c("Death","Inpatient","ED Visit","No Event")),
    had_event = as.integer(first_event_type != "No Event"),
    Gender    = factor(Gender),
    Race      = factor(Race),
    GISURH    = factor(GISURH),
    PriorityGroup = factor(PriorityGroup),
    mst_status    = factor(mst_status),
    tobacco_status = factor(tobacco_status),
    py2_IVC_n   = if_else(is.numeric(py2_IVC_n)   & py2_IVC_n   == 0, NA_real_, as.numeric(py2_IVC_n)),
    py2_IVC_los = if_else(is.numeric(py2_IVC_los) & py2_IVC_los == 0, NA_real_, as.numeric(py2_IVC_los)),
    py_ed         = factor(as.integer(py_ed)),
    py_urgent     = factor(as.integer(py_urgent)),
    py_appt_no_show = factor(as.integer(py_appt_no_show))
  )

dt_analysis %>% write_parquet("data//output//dt_analysis.parquet")
patient_summary %>% write_parquet("data//output//patient_summary.parquet")
tbl1_data %>% write_parquet("data//output//tbl1_data.parquet")

# ── Save snapshots for CONSORT diagnostics ────────────────────────────────────
# Save dt_weekly (post-rolling, pre-CONSORT) for re-running diagnostic filters
as_tibble(dt_weekly) %>% write_parquet("data/output/dt_weekly_snapshot.parquet")
as_tibble(event_types) %>% write_parquet("data/output/event_types_snapshot.parquet")

```

```{r train-test, include=FALSE, cache=TRUE, dependson="consort-pipeline"}

#dt_analysis <- open_dataset("data//output//dt_analysis.parquet") %>% collect()


# ── Build modeling_data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
modeling_data <- as_tibble(dt_analysis) %>%
  left_join(cohort_static %>% select(
    PatientICN, Age, Gender, Race, Ethnicity,
    any_of(c("Married","MaritalStatus")), GISURH, PriorityGroup,
    starts_with("py2_"), py_ed, py_urgent, py_appt_no_show,
    bmi_slope, bmi_fitted_mean, bmi_fitted_last,
    map_slope, map_fitted_mean, map_fitted_last, recent_pulse,
    bun_value_mean, bun_value_last, albumin_value_mean, albumin_value_last,
    leuk_value_mean, leuk_value_last, mst_status, tobacco_status),
    by = "PatientICN") %>%
  mutate(
    Y  = calc_y_horizon(days_to_event, 30L),  # placeholder; overridden in fit function
    Gender    = factor(Gender), Race    = factor(Race),
    Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity),
    GISURH    = factor(GISURH), PriorityGroup = factor(PriorityGroup),
    mst_status = factor(mst_status),
    current_smoker = factor(if_else(tolower(as.character(tobacco_status)) == "current smoker",
                                    1L, 0L)),
    never_smoker   = factor(if_else(tolower(as.character(tobacco_status)) == "never smoker",
                                    1L, 0L)),
    season = factor(case_when(
        month(weekly_end_date) %in% c(12,1,2)  ~ "Winter",
        month(weekly_end_date) %in% c(3,4,5)   ~ "Spring",
        month(weekly_end_date) %in% c(6,7,8)   ~ "Summer",
        month(weekly_end_date) %in% c(9,10,11) ~ "Fall"),
      levels = c("Winter","Spring","Summer","Fall")))

# ── Drop columns ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
drop_cols <- c("PatientICN","date","weekly_end_date","obs_end","first_event_date",
               "upload_episode","ep_order","first_ep_order","ep_valid","window_has_core",
               "first_event_type","days_to_event","event_within_window","censor_date",
               "obs_window_end","weekly_interval_index",
               "first_upload_date","baseline_end_date","tobacco_status")

step_cols_baseline <- c("baseline_k_steps_avg","baseline_k_steps_miss_days")
step_cols_dynamic  <- c("k_steps_7d_avg","k_steps_7d_avg_pctdiff","k_steps_7d_miss_days",
                        "k_steps_7d_all_missing","k_steps_7d_pct_from_baseline","k_steps_7d_sd",
                        "low_activity_days_7d","low_activity_streak",
                        "k_steps_14d_avg","k_steps_14d_sd","k_steps_21d_avg","k_steps_21d_sd")
step_cols <- c(step_cols_baseline, step_cols_dynamic)
static_cols <- setdiff(names(modeling_data),
                       c("Y", drop_cols, step_cols, "days_to_event"))
static_cols <- intersect(static_cols, names(modeling_data))

# ── 70/30 patient-level train/test split ─────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(2026L)
all_pts  <- unique(modeling_data$PatientICN)
train_pts <- sample(all_pts, floor(0.7 * length(all_pts)))
test_pts  <- setdiff(all_pts, train_pts)

keep_all <- c("Y", "PatientICN", "days_to_event",
              intersect(c(step_cols, static_cols), names(modeling_data)))
modeling_data <- modeling_data %>% select(all_of(intersect(keep_all, names(modeling_data))))

train_data <- modeling_data %>% filter(PatientICN %in% train_pts)
test_data  <- modeling_data %>% filter(PatientICN %in% test_pts)
```

```{r model-fitting, include=FALSE, cache=TRUE, dependson="train-test"}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIT 12 MODELS: 3 feature_sets × 2 horizons × 2 algorithms
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fit_m1_one <- function(feature_mode, horizon, model_type,
                       train_data_in = train_data, test_data_in = test_data) {
  avail_step   <- intersect(step_cols,   names(train_data_in))
  avail_static <- intersect(static_cols, names(train_data_in))

  keep_feats <- switch(feature_mode,
    model1_steps_only       = avail_step,
    model2_static_only      = avail_static,
    model3_steps_and_static = union(avail_step, avail_static))
  if (length(keep_feats) == 0L) return(NULL)

  model_cols <- c("PatientICN","days_to_event", keep_feats)
  tr <- train_data_in %>% select(all_of(intersect(model_cols, names(train_data_in)))) %>%
    mutate(Y = calc_y_horizon(days_to_event, horizon)) %>%
    select(-days_to_event)                        # keep PatientICN for undersampling
  te <- test_data_in  %>% select(all_of(intersect(model_cols, names(test_data_in)))) %>%
    mutate(Y = calc_y_horizon(days_to_event, horizon)) %>%
    select(-PatientICN, -days_to_event)

  if (sum(tr$Y) < 5L || sum(te$Y) < 5L) return(NULL)

  # True imbalance ratio computed on full training data (before undersampling)
  spw_true <- sum(tr$Y == 0) / max(sum(tr$Y == 1), 1)

  # Logistic: undersample 3:1 (patient-aware). XGBoost: full training data + scale_pos_weight.
  # Undersampling for XGBoost compresses predicted probabilities, inflating calibration slopes.
  tr_under <- as.data.frame(undersample_by_patient(tr) %>% select(-PatientICN))
  tr_full  <- as.data.frame(tr %>% select(-PatientICN))

  y_te <- te$Y

  if (model_type == "logistic") {
    tr   <- tr_under
    rec  <- make_recipe_glmnet(tr)
    prp  <- prep(rec, training = tr, retain = TRUE)
    trb  <- bake(prp, new_data = tr); teb  <- bake(prp, new_data = te)
    imb  <- sum(trb$Y == 0) / max(sum(trb$Y == 1), 1)
    wts  <- ifelse(trb$Y == 1, imb, 1.0)
    fit  <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(glm(Y ~ ., data = trb, family = binomial(), weights = wts)),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
    pred_raw <- predict(fit, newdata = teb, type = "response")
    coef_tbl <- broom::tidy(fit) %>%
      mutate(odds_ratio = exp(estimate), feature_mode = feature_mode,
             horizon = horizon, model_type = model_type)
    final_fit <- fit
  } else {
    rec  <- make_recipe_xgboost(tr_full)
    prp  <- prep(rec, training = tr_full, retain = TRUE)
    trb  <- bake(prp, new_data = tr_full); teb  <- bake(prp, new_data = te)
    y_tr <- as.numeric(trb$Y)
    x_tr <- as.matrix(trb %>% select(-Y) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)))
    x_te <- as.matrix(teb %>% select(-Y) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)))
    # Full training data + scale_pos_weight = true imbalance ratio.
    # Avoids the probability compression that occurs when training on undersampled data.
    dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(x_tr, label = y_tr)
    dtest  <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(x_te, label = y_te)
    fit    <- xgboost::xgb.train(
      params = list(objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "auc",
                    eta = 0.05, max_depth = 5, min_child_weight = 3,
                    subsample = 0.7, colsample_bytree = 0.7,
                    scale_pos_weight = spw_true),
      data = dtrain, nrounds = 200L, verbose = 0L,
      watchlist = list(train = dtrain, test = dtest), early_stopping_rounds = 15L)
    pred_raw <- predict(fit, dtest)
    imp      <- xgboost::xgb.importance(model = fit)
    coef_tbl <- tibble(term = imp$Feature, gain = imp$Gain,
                       cover = imp$Cover, frequency = imp$Frequency,
                       feature_mode = feature_mode, horizon = horizon, model_type = model_type)
    final_fit <- fit
  }

  # Calibration slope on raw (pre-Platt) predictions — Option A
  eps_cal       <- 1e-6
  logit_raw     <- log(pmax(eps_cal, pred_raw) / pmax(eps_cal, 1 - pred_raw))
  cal_slope_raw <- tryCatch(
    coef(suppressWarnings(glm(as.integer(y_te) ~ logit_raw, family = binomial())))["logit_raw"],
    error = function(e) NA_real_)

  # Platt scaling (used for AUC and PR-AUC; Brier retained in data but not reported)
  pl  <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(glm(y_te ~ pred_raw, family = binomial())),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  pred <- if (!is.null(pl)) predict(pl, type = "response") else pred_raw
  m    <- compute_global_metrics(as.integer(y_te), pred)

  list(
    summary = tibble(feature_mode = feature_mode, horizon = horizon, model_type = model_type,
                     auc = round(m$auc, 4), pr_auc = round(m$pr_auc, 4),
                     brier = round(m$brier, 5), cal_slope = round(cal_slope_raw, 4),
                     n_test = length(y_te), events_test = sum(as.integer(y_te))),
    roc  = m$roc,
    pred = pred, y = as.integer(y_te),
    coef_tbl = coef_tbl,
    calibration = make_calibration_table(pred, as.integer(y_te)),
    fit  = final_fit,
    feature_mode = feature_mode, horizon = horizon, model_type = model_type
  )
}
```

```{r model-run, include=FALSE, cache=TRUE, dependson="model-fitting"}
feature_sets <- c("model1_steps_only","model2_static_only","model3_steps_and_static")
horizons     <- c(14L, 30L)
model_types  <- c("logistic","xgboost")

m1_results <- list()
for (fm in feature_sets) {
  for (hz in horizons) {
    for (mt in model_types) {
      res <- tryCatch(fit_m1_one(fm, hz, mt), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(res)) m1_results <- append(m1_results, list(res))
    }
  }
}

m1_summaries  <- bind_rows(lapply(m1_results, `[[`, "summary"))
```

```{r sensitivity-run, include=FALSE, cache=TRUE, dependson="model-run"}
# ── Sensitivity A: relaxed quality filter (miss_days <= 6 vs primary <= 3) ────
# Re-derive analysis dataset from dt_weekly with the relaxed filter
dt_analysis_sa <- merge(
  dt_weekly[k_steps_7d_miss_days <= 6],
  event_types, by = "PatientICN", all.x = TRUE)
dt_analysis_sa[, days_to_event   := as.integer(first_event_date - weekly_end_date)]
dt_analysis_sa[is.na(first_event_type), first_event_type := "No Event"]
dt_analysis_sa[, first_upload_date := min(weekly_end_date), by = PatientICN]
dt_analysis_sa <- dt_analysis_sa[first_upload_date <= followup_cutoff]
pt_wk_cts_sa <- dt_analysis_sa[, .(tot = .N), by = PatientICN]
dt_analysis_sa <- dt_analysis_sa[PatientICN %in% pt_wk_cts_sa[tot >= 7L, PatientICN]]
baseline_metrics_sa <- dt_analysis_sa[weekly_interval_index <= 6L,
  .(baseline_k_steps_avg       = mean(k_steps_7d_avg,       na.rm = TRUE),
    baseline_k_steps_miss_days = mean(k_steps_7d_miss_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    baseline_end_date          = max(weekly_end_date)),
  by = PatientICN]
dt_analysis_sa <- merge(dt_analysis_sa, baseline_metrics_sa, by = "PatientICN", all.x = TRUE)
# Step 3b mirror: exclude patients with event during baseline
event_in_baseline_sa <- dt_analysis_sa[
  weekly_interval_index <= 6L & !is.na(first_event_date),
  .(baseline_event = any(as.Date(first_event_date) <= as.Date(baseline_end_date))),
  by = PatientICN][baseline_event == TRUE, PatientICN]
dt_analysis_sa <- dt_analysis_sa[PatientICN %!in% event_in_baseline_sa]
dt_analysis_sa <- dt_analysis_sa[!is.na(baseline_k_steps_avg) & weekly_interval_index > 6L]
dt_analysis_sa[, k_steps_7d_pct_from_baseline :=
  100 * (k_steps_7d_avg - baseline_k_steps_avg) / baseline_k_steps_avg]
dt_analysis_sa[, obs_window_end := first_upload_date + max_follow_up_days]
dt_analysis_sa[, event_within_window := !is.na(first_event_date) & first_event_date <= obs_window_end]
dt_analysis_sa[, censor_date := fifelse(
  event_within_window,
  as.character(first_event_date),
  as.character(obs_window_end))]
dt_analysis_sa <- dt_analysis_sa[weekly_end_date <= as.Date(censor_date)]
dt_analysis_sa[event_within_window == FALSE,
  `:=`(first_event_date = NA_Date_, days_to_event = NA_integer_, first_event_type = "No Event")]

# Helper: add cohort_static features + derived columns, then select keep_all columns.
# Mirrors the modeling_data pipeline so static_cols / step_cols are found correctly.
build_modeling_df <- function(dt_in) {
  as_tibble(dt_in) %>%
    left_join(cohort_static %>% select(
      PatientICN, Age, Gender, Race, Ethnicity,
      any_of(c("Married","MaritalStatus")), GISURH, PriorityGroup,
      starts_with("py2_"), py_ed, py_urgent, py_appt_no_show,
      bmi_slope, bmi_fitted_mean, bmi_fitted_last,
      map_slope, map_fitted_mean, map_fitted_last, recent_pulse,
      bun_value_mean, bun_value_last, albumin_value_mean, albumin_value_last,
      leuk_value_mean, leuk_value_last, mst_status, tobacco_status),
      by = "PatientICN") %>%
    mutate(
      Gender    = factor(Gender), Race = factor(Race),
      Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity),
      GISURH    = factor(GISURH), PriorityGroup = factor(PriorityGroup),
      mst_status = factor(mst_status),
      current_smoker = factor(if_else(tolower(as.character(tobacco_status)) == "current smoker", 1L, 0L)),
      never_smoker   = factor(if_else(tolower(as.character(tobacco_status)) == "never smoker",   1L, 0L)),
      season = factor(case_when(
        month(weekly_end_date) %in% c(12,1,2)  ~ "Winter",
        month(weekly_end_date) %in% c(3,4,5)   ~ "Spring",
        month(weekly_end_date) %in% c(6,7,8)   ~ "Summer",
        month(weekly_end_date) %in% c(9,10,11) ~ "Fall"),
        levels = c("Winter","Spring","Summer","Fall"))) %>%
    select(all_of(intersect(keep_all, names(.))))
}

# Fit sensitivity A models (30d only) — pass SA train/test directly via overrides
md_sa    <- build_modeling_df(dt_analysis_sa)
md_sa_tr <- md_sa %>% filter(PatientICN %in% train_pts)
md_sa_te <- md_sa %>% filter(PatientICN %in% test_pts)

sa_results <- list()
for (fm in feature_sets) {
  for (mt in model_types) {
    res_sa <- tryCatch(
      fit_m1_one(fm, 30L, mt, train_data_in = md_sa_tr, test_data_in = md_sa_te),
      error = function(e) { message("SA error ", fm, "/", mt, ": ", e$message); NULL })
    if (!is.null(res_sa)) sa_results <- append(sa_results, list(res_sa))
  }
}
sa_summaries <- bind_rows(lapply(sa_results, `[[`, "summary")) %>%
  mutate(sensitivity = "A_relaxed_filter")

```{r}
m1_summaries  <- bind_rows(lapply(m1_results, `[[`, "summary"))

# Wide-format performance table (horizons as columns)
m1_perf_wide <- m1_summaries %>%
  mutate(feature_label = recode(feature_mode, !!!feat_labels),
         algo = str_to_title(model_type)) %>%
  select(feature_label, algo, horizon, auc, pr_auc, brier, cal_slope, n_test, events_test) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = horizon,
    values_from = c(auc, pr_auc, brier, cal_slope, n_test, events_test),
    names_glue  = "{.value}_{horizon}d"
  ) %>%
  arrange(algo, feature_label)
```
---

# Methods

## Data

This study uses Patient-Generated Health Data (PGHD) from the VA Wearable Technology Program, in which Veterans voluntarily enrolled and shared wearable device data (Fitbit, Garmin, or Apple Health). Data were obtained from **`r data_start_date`** through **`r data_end_date`**. Daily step counts from Fitbit and Garmin devices were prioritized (using the higher value when both were present); Apple Health data served as an alternative when Fitbit/Garmin data were unavailable. A total of `r format(sum(!is.na(dt_daily$fit_garmin_steps) | !is.na(dt_daily$apple_steps)), big.mark = ",")` patient-days had usable step data; Fitbit/Garmin data were available for `r round(100 * mean(!is.na(dt_daily$fit_garmin_steps), na.rm = TRUE), 1)`% and Apple Health for the remainder. Daily step counts of zero were treated as missing, and outliers were removed using the 1.5×IQR method applied to raw device columns. Where step data were missing but exercise duration (minutes) was recorded, steps were imputed from a linear regression model fit on matched days (`steps ~ exercise_minutes`).

## Cohort Derivation (Figure 1)

Starting from all Veterans with a first PGHD upload on or after September 1, 2023 (N = `r format(n0_pts, big.mark=",")`), we applied the sequential eligibility criteria described in Figure 1. The September 1, 2023 start date reflects a 90-day grace period after the PGHD data extract window opens (June 1, 2023), ensuring that only incident enrollees — Veterans whose first observed upload falls within the study window — are included; patients with a June 1 "first upload" are left-truncated prevalent uploaders whose true enrollment date is unknown. To ensure a uniform follow-up window of `r max_follow_up_days %/% 7L` weeks across all patients, we required Veterans' first upload to fall on or before **`r followup_cutoff_label`** (derived as the latest first-upload date for which `r max_follow_up_days %/% 7L` weeks of potential observation remain before the data end date). We then applied a weekly data quality filter requiring at least four upload days per 7-day window (`miss_days ≤ 3`), and retained only patients with a minimum of seven qualifying weeks total — six of which constitute the baseline period (weeks 1–6) and at least one subsequent observation week. Patients whose composite event (ED visit, inpatient admission, or death) occurred during the six-week baseline were additionally excluded, as no event-free anchor period exists for them. Observation windows were then censored at the date of a first composite event or at `r max_follow_up_days %/% 7L` weeks from first upload, whichever came first. The final analytic cohort included **`r format(n4_pts, big.mark=",")` Veterans** contributing **`r format(n4_wks, big.mark=",")` person-weeks** of observation (weeks 7+).

## Step Feature Construction

At each observation week, a suite of step-derived features was computed from the 7-day, 14-day, and 21-day rolling windows anchored to the calendar week end-date. The primary current-activity features include the 7-day rolling average daily step count (`k_steps_7d_avg`, thousands), the rolling standard deviation (`k_steps_7d_sd`), the number of missing days in the window (`k_steps_7d_miss_days`), and the count of days with <1,000 steps (`low_activity_days_7d`). Two change metrics capture temporal trends: percent change from the average of the prior three 7-day windows (`k_steps_7d_avg_pctdiff`, winsorized at ±500%) and percent change from the 6-week baseline average (`k_steps_7d_pct_from_baseline`). Analogous 14-day and 21-day rolling averages and standard deviations provide longer-horizon smoothed signals. Two baseline summary features — mean steps and mean missing days across weeks 1–6 — anchor the within-person normalization.

## Outcome Definition

The primary outcome was a composite of ED visit, inpatient admission, or death occurring within the prediction horizon (14 or 30 days) following a given observation week's end date. The outcome was labeled positive (Y = 1) if any component occurred within 1 to *h* days (`days_to_event ∈ [1, h]`), and negative (Y = 0) otherwise. Observations within 30 days of the end of follow-up without a recorded event were excluded if the outcome window was not fully observed.

## Statistical Analysis

We fit three feature sets: (1) step-derived features only (baseline + dynamic, *n* = 14 features); (2) static clinical features only (demographics, comorbidity flags, prior healthcare utilization, vitals, labs, and social history); and (3) the combined set. For each feature set and each prediction horizon (14-day and 30-day), we trained two algorithm types: penalized logistic regression (with elastic-net preprocessing) and gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost). Patients were randomly assigned to training (70%) and testing (30%) sets; all observation-weeks for a given patient remained in the same partition. To address class imbalance, logistic regression models were trained on patient-aware 3:1 undersampled data with case weights applied proportionally; XGBoost models were trained on the full (non-undersampled) training data with `scale_pos_weight` set to the true negative-to-positive ratio, avoiding the probability compression that results from training and scoring on different class distributions. Predicted probabilities were Platt-scaled (logistic calibration) on the test set; Platt-scaled probabilities were used to compute AUC-ROC and PR-AUC. Calibration slope was computed on the raw (pre-calibration) model output to provide an unbiased measure of model calibration. Brier score was computed but is not reported as a primary metric, as the low event rate (<3% per week) renders it statistically equivalent to the null (intercept-only) model.

## Figure 1. Cohort Derivation

```{r consort-table, echo=FALSE}
consort_df <- tribble(
  ~Step, ~Criterion, ~Veterans, ~`Person-weeks`,
  "0 — Incident enrollees",
    paste0("First PGHD upload ≥ September 1, 2023 (90-day grace period to exclude left-truncated prevalent uploaders; data window opens June 1, 2023): ", data_start_date, " – ", data_end_date),
    format(n0_pts, big.mark = ","), format(n0_wks, big.mark = ","),
  "1 — Uniform follow-up window",
    paste0("First PGHD upload on or before ", followup_cutoff_label, " (ensures ≥", max_follow_up_days %/% 7L, " weeks of potential follow-up for every patient)"),
    format(n1_pts, big.mark = ","), format(n1_wks, big.mark = ","),
  "2 — Weekly data quality",
    "\u22654 days with step data in a given 7-day window (miss_days \u2264 3)",
    format(n2_pts, big.mark = ","), format(n2_wks, big.mark = ","),
  "3 — Minimum 6 event-free baseline weeks",
    "Minimum of six consecutive event-free weeks (baseline period)",
    format(n3_pts, big.mark = ","), format(n3_wks, big.mark = ","),
  "3b — Event-free baseline required",
    "Exclude patients whose composite event occurred during weeks 1–6 (no event-free baseline available)",
    format(n3b_pts, big.mark = ","), format(n3b_wks, big.mark = ","),
  "4 — Censor at first event or follow-up window end",
    paste0("Remove person-weeks occurring after first composite event or after ", max_follow_up_days %/% 7L, " weeks of follow-up"),
    paste0("**", format(n4_pts, big.mark = ","), "**"),
    paste0("**", format(n4_wks, big.mark = ","), "**")
)

consort_df %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Figure 1. Cohort derivation flow table for Study 1. Person-weeks shown for observation period (weeks 7+) at steps 3–4; earlier rows show total qualifying weekly rows before baseline/observation split.",
    align   = c("l","l","r","r"),
    escape  = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed","hover"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
  row_spec(6, bold = TRUE, background = "#e8f4e8") %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "18em") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "30em") %>%
  column_spec(3:4, width = "7em")
```

## Cohort Derivation Diagnostics

The sections below inspect each CONSORT exclusion step to verify that exclusions are appropriate. These are computed by re-applying each filter in isolation from a snapshot of the weekly data (`dt_weekly_snapshot`) taken after rolling-feature construction but before any CONSORT filtering.

```{r consort-diagnostics, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONSORT DIAGNOSTICS — re-runs each step in isolation to expose who is
# excluded and why.  Loads from snapshots saved in consort-pipeline.
# Results saved to data/output/consort_diag_step*.parquet for display chunks.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
library(arrow); library(tidyverse); library(data.table)

dt_wk  <- open_dataset("data/output/dt_weekly_snapshot.parquet") %>% collect() %>% as.data.table()
evt    <- open_dataset("data/output/event_types_snapshot.parquet") %>% collect()

# dt_weekly_snapshot has no first_upload_date column — derive it
dt_wk[, weekly_end_date   := as.Date(weekly_end_date)]
dt_wk[, first_upload_date := min(weekly_end_date), by = PatientICN]

# Merge events
dt_wk <- merge(dt_wk, evt, by = "PatientICN", all.x = TRUE)
dt_wk[is.na(first_event_type), first_event_type := "No Event"]
dt_wk[, days_to_event := as.integer(as.Date(first_event_date) - weekly_end_date)]

# Starting counts (post-rolling, all episodes valid)
n_start_pts <- uniqueN(dt_wk$PatientICN)
n_start_wks <- nrow(dt_wk)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Step 1 Sensitivity: shift follow-up cutoff by ±6 months
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
step1_cutoffs <- as.Date(c("2024-09-30", "2025-03-31", "2025-09-30"))
step1_labels  <- c("-6 months", "Current (2025-03-31)", "+6 months")

step1_diag <- map2_dfr(step1_cutoffs, step1_labels, function(cutoff, lbl) {
  kept <- dt_wk[first_upload_date < cutoff]
  tibble(
    label       = lbl,
    cutoff      = as.character(cutoff),
    n_patients  = uniqueN(kept$PatientICN),
    n_weeks     = nrow(kept),
    pct_of_start = round(100 * uniqueN(kept$PatientICN) / n_start_pts, 1)
  )
})

# Distribution of first_upload_date for annotation
step1_dist <- dt_wk %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  distinct(PatientICN, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(first_upload_date = as.Date(first_upload_date)) %>%
  count(month = lubridate::floor_date(first_upload_date, "month"), name = "n_patients")

step1_diag   %>% write_parquet("data/output/consort_diag_step1.parquet")
step1_dist   %>% write_parquet("data/output/consort_diag_step1_dist.parquet")
rm(step1_diag, step1_dist)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Step 2 Sensitivity: weekly data quality (miss_days threshold)
# Thresholds: require ≥1..7 days present → miss_days ≤ 6,5,4,3,2,1,0
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Apply step-1 primary first so counts are comparable to primary analysis
dt_s1 <- dt_wk[first_upload_date < as.Date("2025-03-31")]

step2_thresholds <- 0:6   # miss_days ≤ this value
step2_min_days   <- 7 - step2_thresholds  # days present required

step2_diag <- map2_dfr(step2_thresholds, step2_min_days, function(thresh, min_d) {
  kept <- dt_s1[k_steps_7d_miss_days <= thresh]
  tibble(
    miss_days_threshold = thresh,
    days_required       = min_d,
    label               = paste0("≤", thresh, " missing (≥", min_d, " days present)",
                                 if_else(thresh == 3, " [current]", "")),
    n_patients          = uniqueN(kept$PatientICN),
    n_weeks             = nrow(kept),
    pct_patients_retained = round(100 * uniqueN(kept$PatientICN) / uniqueN(dt_s1$PatientICN), 1),
    pct_weeks_retained    = round(100 * nrow(kept) / nrow(dt_s1), 1)
  )
})

# Distribution of miss_days across all rows (after step-1)
step2_dist <- dt_s1 %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  count(miss_days = k_steps_7d_miss_days, name = "n_weeks") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n_weeks / sum(n_weeks), 1))

step2_diag %>% write_parquet("data/output/consort_diag_step2.parquet")
step2_dist %>% write_parquet("data/output/consort_diag_step2_dist.parquet")
rm(step2_diag, step2_dist, dt_s1)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Step 3 Sensitivity: baseline length (2,4,6,8,10,12 weeks)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dt_s2 <- dt_wk[first_upload_date < as.Date("2025-03-31") & k_steps_7d_miss_days <= 3]

step3_baselines <- c(2L, 4L, 6L, 8L, 10L, 12L)

step3_diag <- map_dfr(step3_baselines, function(bl) {
  min_total <- bl + 1L   # bl baseline + ≥1 observation week
  pt_wk     <- dt_s2[, .(tot = .N), by = PatientICN]
  kept_pts  <- pt_wk[tot >= min_total, PatientICN]
  kept      <- dt_s2[PatientICN %in% kept_pts]
  # Observation weeks (post-baseline)
  obs_wks   <- kept[weekly_interval_index > bl]
  tibble(
    baseline_wks      = bl,
    label             = paste0(bl, " weeks", if_else(bl == 6L, " [current]", "")),
    n_patients        = uniqueN(kept$PatientICN),
    n_obs_weeks       = nrow(obs_wks),
    pct_of_s2_pts     = round(100 * uniqueN(kept$PatientICN) / uniqueN(dt_s2$PatientICN), 1)
  )
})

# Total weeks distribution (to show natural cliff)
step3_dist <- dt_s2 %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(PatientICN) %>%
  summarise(total_wks = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  count(total_wks, name = "n_patients")

step3_diag %>% write_parquet("data/output/consort_diag_step3.parquet")
step3_dist %>% write_parquet("data/output/consort_diag_step3_dist.parquet")
rm(step3_diag, step3_dist, dt_s2)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Step 4 Diagnostic: understand week-removal at censoring step
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pre4 <- open_dataset("data/output/dt_analysis_pre_step4.parquet") %>% collect() %>% as.data.table()
pre4[, weekly_end_date    := as.Date(weekly_end_date)]
pre4[, first_event_date   := as.Date(first_event_date)]
pre4[, first_upload_date  := as.Date(first_upload_date)]
pre4[, obs_window_end := as.Date(first_upload_date) + max_follow_up_days]

pre4[, event_within_window := !is.na(first_event_date) & first_event_date <= obs_window_end]
pre4[, censor_date := fifelse(
  event_within_window,
  as.character(first_event_date),
  as.character(obs_window_end))]
pre4[, censor_date := as.Date(censor_date)]
pre4[, keep_row := weekly_end_date <= censor_date]

# Summary: patients before vs after (should be same or very close)
step4_patient_summary <- tibble(
  stage          = c("Pre-step4 (post-step3 obs weeks)", "Post-step4 (censored)"),
  n_patients     = c(uniqueN(pre4$PatientICN),
                     uniqueN(pre4[keep_row == TRUE]$PatientICN)),
  n_weeks        = c(nrow(pre4), nrow(pre4[keep_row == TRUE])),
  n_weeks_removed = c(NA_integer_, nrow(pre4[keep_row == FALSE]))
)

# Reason for row removal
step4_removal_reason <- pre4[keep_row == FALSE] %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    removal_reason = case_when(
      event_within_window ~ "Event censoring (row after first event)",
      TRUE                ~ paste0(max_follow_up_days %/% 7L, "-week / end-of-window censoring")
    )
  ) %>%
  count(removal_reason, name = "n_weeks_removed")

# Weekly_interval_index distribution for removed rows
step4_removed_index_dist <- pre4[keep_row == FALSE] %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  count(weekly_interval_index, name = "n_removed") %>%
  arrange(weekly_interval_index)

# Distribution of days_to_event for event-censored rows
step4_event_days_dist <- pre4[keep_row == FALSE & event_within_window == TRUE] %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    days_to_event_at_removal = as.integer(first_event_date - weekly_end_date)
  )

step4_patient_summary    %>% write_parquet("data/output/consort_diag_step4_summary.parquet")
step4_removal_reason     %>% write_parquet("data/output/consort_diag_step4_reason.parquet")
step4_removed_index_dist %>% write_parquet("data/output/consort_diag_step4_index.parquet")
step4_event_days_dist    %>% write_parquet("data/output/consort_diag_step4_event_days.parquet")
rm(pre4, step4_patient_summary, step4_removal_reason, step4_removed_index_dist, step4_event_days_dist)

message("consort-diagnostics complete — all parquets saved to data/output/")
```

```{r diag-step4-charts, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4.5, fig.cap="Left: Distribution of weekly_interval_index for removed person-weeks (weeks dropped by censoring). Right: Distribution of days_to_event at the time of removal for event-censored rows (i.e., how far in the future was the event relative to the dropped week?)."}
if (all(file.exists(c("data/output/consort_diag_step4_index.parquet",
                       "data/output/consort_diag_step4_event_days.parquet")))) {
  d4_idx   <- open_dataset("data/output/consort_diag_step4_index.parquet")      %>% collect()
  d4_evtd  <- open_dataset("data/output/consort_diag_step4_event_days.parquet") %>% collect()

  p_idx <- ggplot(d4_idx, aes(x = weekly_interval_index, y = n_removed)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#d73027", alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(x = "Week index (since first upload)", y = "Weeks removed",
         title = "Removed weeks by week index") +
    theme_science()

  p_evtd <- ggplot(d4_evtd %>% filter(!is.na(days_to_event_at_removal)),
                   aes(x = days_to_event_at_removal)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 7, fill = "#4575b4", alpha = 0.8, color = "white") +
    labs(x = "Days from dropped week to first event", y = "Person-weeks",
         title = "Event-censored: proximity to event") +
    theme_science()

  p_idx + p_evtd
}

## Figure 2. Time to First Composite Event

```{r fig2-survival, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4.5, fig.cap="Figure 2. Kaplan-Meier survival curve for time from first PGHD upload to first composite event (ED visit, inpatient admission, or death) among the analytic cohort. The y-axis shows the proportion of patients remaining event-free. Tick marks indicate censored observations. Shaded band represents the 95% pointwise confidence interval."}
if (!requireNamespace("survival", quietly = TRUE))
  try(install.packages("survival", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org", quiet = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
library(survival)

km_data <- dt_analysis[, .(
  first_upload_date = first(first_upload_date),
  first_event_date  = first(first_event_date),
  first_event_type  = first(first_event_type),
  last_obs_date     = max(weekly_end_date)
), by = PatientICN] %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    surv_time  = as.numeric(if_else(
      !is.na(first_event_date),
      difftime(first_event_date, first_upload_date, units = "days"),
      difftime(last_obs_date,    first_upload_date, units = "days"))),
    event_flag = as.integer(!is.na(first_event_date))
  ) %>%
  filter(surv_time >= 0)

km_fit  <- survfit(Surv(surv_time, event_flag) ~ 1, data = km_data)
km_df   <- data.frame(
  time   = km_fit$time,
  surv   = km_fit$surv,
  lower  = km_fit$lower,
  upper  = km_fit$upper,
  n.cens = km_fit$n.censor
)

n_events  <- sum(km_data$event_flag)
n_total   <- nrow(km_data)
med_surv  <- summary(km_fit)$table["median"]
surv_180  <- round(100 * summary(km_fit, times = 180)$surv,  1)
surv_365  <- round(100 * summary(km_fit, times = 365)$surv,  1)

annot_txt <- sprintf(
  "N = %s  |  Events = %s (%.1f%%)\\nMedian event-free: %s days\\nEvent-free at 180d: %.1f%%  |  365d: %.1f%%",
  format(n_total, big.mark = ","),
  format(n_events, big.mark = ","),
  100 * n_events / n_total,
  ifelse(is.na(med_surv) | is.infinite(med_surv), ">365", round(med_surv, 0)),
  surv_180, surv_365)

ggplot(km_df %>% filter(time <= 365), aes(x = time, y = surv)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "#4575b4", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_step(colour = "#4575b4", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = km_df %>% filter(n.cens > 0),
             aes(x = time, y = surv), shape = 3, size = 1.2,
             colour = "#4575b4", alpha = 0.6) +
  #geom_vline(xintercept = c(180, 365), linetype = "dashed",
  #           colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  #annotate("text", x = 185, y = 0.08, label = "180d", hjust = 0,
   #        size = 2.8, colour = "grey40") +
  #annotate("text", x = 370, y = 0.08, label = "365d", hjust = 0,
  #         size = 2.8, colour = "grey40") +
 # annotate("text", x = 10, y = 0.15, label = annot_txt,
  #         hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 2.6, colour = "grey20",
 #          lineheight = 1.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(.5, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 400, by = 60), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Days from first PGHD upload",
       y = "Proportion event-free",
       title = NULL) +
  theme_science(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3))

## Figure 3. Step Trajectories Before First Event

```{r fig-trajectory, echo=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.cap="Figure 3. Mean 7-day rolling average daily step count (± 1 SE) and mean missing days per week (± 1 SE) in the 8 weeks before first composite event (ED Visit, Inpatient admission, Death) or in a randomly selected reference 8-week window for the No Event group. Dashed vertical line marks the reference week (week −1 = most recent week; week −8 = earliest). Bands represent ± 1 SE across patients. n = number of patients contributing to each group at week −1."}
# Event groups: use actual weeks before first event
event_wks <- as.data.frame(dt_analysis) %>%
  filter(first_event_type %in% c("Death","Inpatient","ED Visit"),
         !is.na(days_to_event)) %>%
  mutate(wk_to_event = -as.integer(ceiling(days_to_event / 7))) %>%
  filter(between(wk_to_event, -8L, -1L)) %>%
  select(PatientICN, first_event_type, wk_to_event,
         k_steps_7d_avg, k_steps_7d_miss_days)

# No-event group: random 8-week window
set.seed(42L)
noevent_wks <- as.data.frame(dt_analysis) %>%
  filter(first_event_type == "No Event") %>%
  group_by(PatientICN) %>%
  filter(n() >= 8L) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    n_int <- nrow(.x); si <- sample.int(max(n_int - 7L, 1L), 1L)
    .x[si:(si + 7L), ] %>% mutate(wk_to_event = seq(-8L, -1L))
  }) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(PatientICN, first_event_type, wk_to_event,
         k_steps_7d_avg, k_steps_7d_miss_days)

traj_df <- bind_rows(event_wks, noevent_wks) %>%
  group_by(first_event_type, wk_to_event) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_steps   = mean(k_steps_7d_avg,       na.rm = TRUE) * 1000,
    se_steps     = sd(k_steps_7d_avg,         na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()) * 1000,
    mean_miss    = mean(k_steps_7d_miss_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_miss      = sd(k_steps_7d_miss_days,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n_pts        = n_distinct(PatientICN),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_pts >= 3L)

week_labels <- setNames(paste0("Wk ", seq(-8,-1)), seq(-8,-1))

p_steps <- traj_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = wk_to_event, y = mean_steps,
             color = first_event_type, group = first_event_type)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_steps - se_steps, ymax = mean_steps + se_steps,
                  fill = first_event_type), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) + geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = event_colors, name = "Group") +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = event_colors, name = "Group") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-8,-1), labels = paste0("Wk ", seq(-8,-1))) +
  geom_text(data = traj_df %>% filter(wk_to_event == -1L),
            aes(label = paste0("n=", n_pts), y = mean_steps + se_steps + 150),
            size = 2.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Daily steps") +
  theme_science() +
  theme(axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.text    = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title   = element_text(size = 8))

p_miss <- traj_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = wk_to_event, y = mean_miss,
             color = first_event_type, group = first_event_type)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_miss - se_miss, ymax = mean_miss + se_miss,
                  fill = first_event_type), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) + geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = event_colors, name = "Group") +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = event_colors, name = "Group") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-8,-1), labels = paste0("Wk ", seq(-8,-1))) +
  labs(x = "Weeks relative to event", y = "Missing days / week") +
  theme_science() +
  theme(axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

p_steps / p_miss
```

## Table 2. Predictive Model Performance

```{r table2, echo=FALSE}
col_order <- c("feature_label","algo",
               "auc_14d","pr_auc_14d","cal_slope_14d","events_test_14d",
               "auc_30d","pr_auc_30d","cal_slope_30d",
               "n_test_30d","events_test_30d")
present_cols <- intersect(col_order, names(m1_perf_wide))

tbl2 <- m1_perf_wide %>% select(all_of(present_cols))

# Bold max AUC in each horizon column
auc14_max <- if ("auc_14d" %in% names(tbl2)) max(tbl2$auc_14d, na.rm = TRUE) else NA
auc30_max <- if ("auc_30d" %in% names(tbl2)) max(tbl2$auc_30d, na.rm = TRUE) else NA

# Null-model (event rate) reference row for PR-AUC context
null_row <- tibble(
  feature_label   = "Null model (event rate)",
  algo            = "",
  auc_14d         = 0.5,
  pr_auc_14d      = round(mean(tbl2$events_test_14d / tbl2$n_test_30d, na.rm=TRUE), 4),
  cal_slope_14d   = NA_real_,
  events_test_14d = as.integer(round(mean(tbl2$events_test_14d, na.rm=TRUE))),
  auc_30d         = 0.5,
  pr_auc_30d      = round(mean(tbl2$events_test_30d / tbl2$n_test_30d, na.rm=TRUE), 4),
  cal_slope_30d   = NA_real_,
  n_test_30d      = as.integer(round(mean(tbl2$n_test_30d, na.rm=TRUE))),
  events_test_30d = as.integer(round(mean(tbl2$events_test_30d, na.rm=TRUE)))
) %>% select(all_of(present_cols))

tbl2_fmt <- bind_rows(null_row, tbl2) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))

# Pack-row indices (offset by 1 for the null row prepended)
logistic_rows <- which(tbl2_fmt$algo == "Logistic")
xgboost_rows  <- which(tbl2_fmt$algo == "Xgboost")

col_names_display <- c(
  "Feature set", "Algorithm",
  "AUC", "PR-AUC", "Cal. slope", "Events",
  "AUC", "PR-AUC", "Cal. slope",
  "Test N", "Events"
)[seq_along(present_cols)]

display_cols <- setdiff(present_cols, "algo")
int_cols     <- grep("^(n_test|events_test|feature_label)", display_cols, value = TRUE)
digits_vec   <- ifelse(display_cols %in% int_cols, 0L, 4L)

tbl2_fmt %>%
  select(-algo) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = col_names_display[-2],
    caption = "Table 2. Model performance on the 30% patient-level hold-out test set. AUC = area under ROC curve; PR-AUC = precision-recall AUC; Cal. slope = calibration slope computed on raw (pre-calibration) model output (1.0 = perfect); Platt-scaled probabilities used for AUC and PR-AUC. The 'Null model (event rate)' row provides a PR-AUC reference equal to the marginal event rate; AUC = 0.5 under the null.",
    digits  = digits_vec,
    format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed","hover"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1,
                     "14-day horizon" = length(intersect(c("auc_14d","pr_auc_14d","cal_slope_14d","events_test_14d"), present_cols)),
                     "30-day horizon" = length(intersect(c("auc_30d","pr_auc_30d","cal_slope_30d","n_test_30d","events_test_30d"), present_cols)))) %>%
  pack_rows("Logistic regression", min(logistic_rows), max(logistic_rows)) %>%
  pack_rows("XGBoost",             min(xgboost_rows),   max(xgboost_rows)) %>%
  row_spec(1, italic = TRUE, color = "grey50") %>%   # style null row
  column_spec(1, width = "12em")
```

# Sensitivity A: primary (miss_days <= 3) vs relaxed (miss_days <= 5) AUC at 30d
primary_30d <- m1_summaries %>%
  filter(horizon == 30L) %>%
  mutate(feature_label = recode(feature_mode, !!!feat_labels),
         algo = str_to_title(model_type)) %>%
  select(feature_label, algo, auc_primary = auc)

sa_30d <- sa_summaries %>%
  filter(horizon == 30L) %>%
  mutate(feature_label = recode(feature_mode, !!!feat_labels),
         algo = str_to_title(model_type)) %>%
  select(feature_label, algo, auc_relaxed = auc)

sens_a_tbl <- left_join(primary_30d, sa_30d, by = c("feature_label","algo")) %>%
  mutate(delta = round(auc_relaxed - auc_primary, 4))

## Table 3. Model Calibration — 14-Day and 30-Day Horizons

```{r table3-calibration, echo=FALSE}
cal_tbl_data <- bind_rows(lapply(m1_results, function(r) {
  r$calibration %>%
    mutate(
      feature_label  = recode(r$feature_mode, !!!feat_labels),
      algo           = str_to_title(r$model_type),
      horizon_label  = paste0(r$horizon, "-day")
    )
}))

if (nrow(cal_tbl_data) > 0) {
  cal_tbl_data %>%
    mutate(
      mean_predicted = round(mean_predicted, 3),
      observed_rate  = round(observed_rate,  3),
      n              = format(n,        big.mark = ","),
      n_events       = format(n_events, big.mark = ",")
    ) %>%
    arrange(horizon_label, feature_label, algo, prob_bin) %>%
    select(
      Horizon              = horizon_label,
      `Feature set`        = feature_label,
      Algorithm            = algo,
      `Predicted prob. bin`= prob_bin,
      N                    = n,
      `Events (n)`         = n_events,
      `Mean predicted`     = mean_predicted,
      `Observed rate`      = observed_rate
    ) %>%
    kable(
      caption = "Table 3. Calibration table for 14-day and 30-day horizon models. For each predicted probability bin, observed event rates are compared to mean predicted probabilities. Well-calibrated models show observed rates close to mean predicted values within each bin.",
      align   = c("l","l","l","l","r","r","r","r")
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed","hover"),
                  full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11) %>%
    collapse_rows(columns = 1:3, valign = "top")
} else {
  cat("*Calibration data not available — ensure models have been fit.*")
}
```

## Figure 4. ROC Curves at 30-Day Horizon

```{r fig3-roc, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4.5, fig.cap="Figure 4. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves for the 30-day composite outcome prediction. Left panel: logistic regression; right panel: XGBoost. Each panel shows three curves corresponding to the three feature sets. AUC values are annotated per curve. Dotted diagonal represents chance performance."}
roc_30d <- Filter(function(r) r$horizon == 30L, m1_results)

roc_df <- bind_rows(lapply(roc_30d, function(r) {
  data.frame(
    fpr  = 1 - r$roc$specificities,
    sens = r$roc$sensitivities,
    feature_label = recode(r$feature_mode, !!!feat_labels),
    algo = str_to_title(r$model_type),
    auc_label = sprintf("AUC = %.3f", as.numeric(pROC::auc(r$roc)))
  )
}))

# AUC annotation positions (pick middle of each curve)
auc_annot <- roc_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature_label, algo) %>%
  dplyr::slice(round(dplyr::n() / 2)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(roc_df %>% dplyr::distinct(feature_label, algo, auc_label), by = c("feature_label","algo"))

make_roc_panel <- function(algo_name) {
  d <- roc_df %>% filter(algo == algo_name)
  a <- auc_annot %>% filter(algo == algo_name)
  ggplot(d, aes(x = fpr, y = sens, color = feature_label, group = feature_label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted",
                linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey60") +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data = a %>% group_by(feature_label) %>% slice(1),
      aes(label = auc_label), size = 2.4, box.padding = 0.3,
      segment.size = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE,
      family = "Helvetica") +
    scale_color_manual(values = feat_colors, name = "Feature set") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = .02)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = .02)) +
    labs(title = algo_name, x = "1 – Specificity", y = "Sensitivity") +
    theme_science() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 7.5),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5),
          plot.title   = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"))
}

# ── AUC summary dot-and-whisker panel ────────────────────────────────────────────
if (exists("m1_summaries") && nrow(m1_summaries) > 0L) {
  p_auc_summary <- m1_summaries %>%
    mutate(
      feature_label = recode(feature_mode, !!!feat_labels),
      algo          = str_to_title(model_type),
      horizon_label = paste0(horizon, "-day")
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = feature_label, y = auc,
               color = horizon_label, shape = algo,
               group = interaction(algo, horizon_label))) +
    geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(0.35)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = interaction(algo, horizon_label)),
              position = position_dodge(0.35), linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("14-day" = "#4575b4", "30-day" = "#d73027"),
                       name = "Horizon") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Logistic" = 16L, "Xgboost" = 17L),
                       name = "Algorithm") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1),
                       labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    labs(title = "AUC by Feature Set & Horizon",
         x = "Feature set", y = "AUC (ROC)") +
    theme_science() +
    theme(axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text    = element_text(size = 7.5),
          legend.title   = element_text(size = 7.5))
} else {
  p_auc_summary <- ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = "AUC summary unavailable")
}

# Install ggrepel if needed
if (!requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE))
  try(install.packages("ggrepel", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org", quiet = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
if (!requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) library(ggrepel)

tryCatch({
  library(ggrepel)
  make_roc_panel("Logistic") + make_roc_panel("Xgboost") + p_auc_summary +
    plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}, error = function(e) {
  # Fallback without ggrepel labels
  roc_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = fpr, y = sens, color = feature_label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=0,linetype="dotted",linewidth=0.3, color="grey60") +
    facet_wrap(~algo) +
    scale_color_manual(values = feat_colors, name = "Feature set") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy=1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy=1)) +
    labs(x = "1 – Specificity", y = "Sensitivity") +
    theme_science() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
})
```
