## Figure 5. XGBoost Feature Importance — Steps + Static Model (30-day)

```{r fig4-importance, echo=FALSE, fig.height=7, fig.cap="Figure 5. Top 20 XGBoost Feature Importances (Gain) \u2014 Steps + Static, 30-Day Horizon. Bars filled by feature category (colorblind-friendly Set2 palette). Step-derived features (PGHD / Step) are shown in bold on the y-axis. x-axis values show percentage-point gain; labels show gain \u00d7 100. Gain = fractional contribution to total information gain across all trees."}
xgb_combined_30d <- Filter(function(r)
  r$feature_mode == "model3_steps_and_static" &
  r$horizon == 30L & r$model_type == "xgboost",
  m1_results)

if (length(xgb_combined_30d) > 0) {
  imp_tbl <- xgb_combined_30d[[1]]$coef_tbl %>%
    arrange(desc(gain)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>%
    mutate(
      Category = classify_feature(term),
      Gain     = round(gain, 5),
      Feature  = term
    )

  # Human-readable display names (abbreviated but meaningful)
  feat_display_names <- c(
    # Step / PGHD features
    baseline_k_steps_avg       = "Baseline avg. steps/day",
    baseline_k_steps_miss_days = "Baseline avg. missing days/wk",
    k_steps_7d_avg             = "7-day avg. steps/day",
    k_steps_7d_sd              = "7-day SD steps/day",
    k_steps_7d_miss_days       = "Missing days/wk (7-day)",
    k_steps_7d_all_missing     = "All days missing (7-day)",
    k_steps_7d_pct_from_baseline = "% from baseline steps",
    k_steps_7d_avg_pctdiff     = "% change vs prior 3 wks",
    low_activity_days_7d       = "Low-activity days (7-day)",
    low_activity_streak        = "Consecutive low-activity days",
    k_steps_14d_avg            = "14-day avg. steps/day",
    k_steps_14d_sd             = "14-day SD steps/day",
    k_steps_21d_avg            = "21-day avg. steps/day",
    k_steps_21d_sd             = "21-day SD steps/day",
    # Static — vitals / labs
    bmi_fitted_mean            = "BMI (fitted mean)",
    bmi_slope                  = "BMI trajectory slope",
    bmi_fitted_last            = "BMI (fitted, most recent)",
    map_fitted_mean            = "MAP (fitted mean, mmHg)",
    map_fitted_last            = "MAP (fitted, most recent, mmHg)",
    map_slope                  = "MAP trajectory slope",
    recent_pulse               = "Recent pulse (bpm)",
    bun_value_mean             = "BUN (mean, mg/dL)",
    bun_value_last             = "BUN (most recent, mg/dL)",
    albumin_value_mean         = "Albumin (mean, g/dL)",
    albumin_value_last         = "Albumin (most recent, g/dL)",
    leuk_value_mean            = "WBC (mean, K/\u00b5L)",
    leuk_value_last            = "WBC (most recent, K/\u00b5L)",
    # Demographics
    Age                        = "Age (years)",
    # Healthcare use
    py_ed                      = "Any ED visit (prior yr)",
    py_urgent                  = "Any urgent care (prior yr)",
    py_appt_no_show            = "Appointment no-show (prior yr)",
    py2_inpat_any              = "Any inpatient admission (2yr)",
    py2_inpat_med_surg         = "Med/surgical admission (2yr)",
    py2_inpat_mental_health    = "Mental health admission (2yr)",
    py2_mwi_score              = "Multimorbidity index (MWI)",
    # Condition flags
    py2_congestive_heart_failure = "CHF (2yr)",
    py2_heart_arrhythmias      = "Cardiac arrhythmia (2yr)",
    py2_drug_alcohol_dependence = "Substance use disorder (2yr)",
    py2_metastatic_cancer      = "Metastatic cancer (2yr)",
    py2_lung_severe_cancers    = "Lung/severe cancer (2yr)",
    py2_dialysis_status        = "Dialysis (2yr)",
    py2_housing_instability    = "Housing instability (2yr)",
    py2_financial_sdoh         = "Financial hardship (2yr)",
    # Social history
    mst_status                 = "Military sexual trauma",
    current_smoker             = "Current smoker",
    never_smoker               = "Never smoker"
  )

  # Apply display names; fall back to cleaning up dummy-encoded column names
  imp_tbl <- imp_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      Feature_label = case_when(
        term %in% names(feat_display_names) ~ feat_display_names[term],
        str_detect(term, "^Gender_")      ~ paste0("Sex: ", str_remove(term, "^Gender_")),
        str_detect(term, "^Race_")        ~ paste0("Race: ", str_remove(term, "^Race_")),
        str_detect(term, "^Ethnicity_")   ~ paste0("Ethnicity: ", str_remove(term, "^Ethnicity_")),
        str_detect(term, "^GISURH_")      ~ paste0("Rural/Urban: ", str_remove(term, "^GISURH_")),
        str_detect(term, "^PriorityGroup_") ~ paste0("Priority: ", str_remove(term, "^PriorityGroup_")),
        str_detect(term, "^season_")      ~ paste0("Season: ", str_remove(term, "^season_")),
        TRUE ~ term
      )
    )

  ggplot(imp_tbl,
         aes(x = Gain, y = reorder(Feature_label, Gain), fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(Gain * 100, 2)),
              hjust = -0.1, size = 2.5) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Feature category") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
    labs(
      title = "Figure 5. Top 20 XGBoost Feature Importances (Gain) \u2014 Steps + Static, 30-Day Horizon",
      x     = "Gain (fraction of total information gain)",
      y     = NULL
    ) +
    theme_science() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title      = element_text(size = 9)
    )
} else {
  cat("XGBoost model for Steps + Static at 30-day horizon not available.")
}
